sections.heading: GLS University vs Rai University for LLM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a placement winner, because neither university has an LLM placement record in our database.
On recorded year tuition the sides are close: ₹60,000 at GLS University and ₹70,000 at Rai University. Confirm both official circulars, including any one-year versus two-year duration.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: GLS University has recorded LLM tuition of ₹60,000 a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed programme total, until you check the official notice for the course duration.
Rai University has recorded tuition of ₹70,000 a year, plus an application fee of ₹600. The application fee is not the programme tuition. Confirm Rai's official LLM circular.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has a placement row on this page. Do not assume a package that we do not hold.
Ask each university for its latest official LLM placement or internship report, and compare the same graduating year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. LLM admissions may use a university test, CLAT PG, or LL.B. marks, depending on the institute.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility and duration.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different sites.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the official fee, duration and recognition will decide more than the city name.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On recorded year tuition, GLS University is slightly lower, at ₹60,000 against Rai's ₹70,000.
Because placements are missing, use official recognition, specialisation and the current fee circular to decide.
Do not use Rai's ₹600 application fee as the programme cost.
